faq.q: What specific material properties make Titanium Fuel Pool Rack Spacer suitable for Nuclear fuel storage rack spacer grid?
faq.a: Titanium Fuel Pool Rack Spacer uses Grade 2 CP-Ti because its yield strength, fatigue endurance, and corrosion resistance directly address nuclear hardware operational demands. The alloy's specific strength enables mass reduction without section compromise, while the TiO2 passivation ensures long-term environmental resistance.

faq.q: What are the critical dimensional tolerances for Titanium Fuel Pool Rack Spacer?
faq.a: Standard machining tolerance for Titanium Fuel Pool Rack Spacer is +/-0.05mm (ISO 2768-m). Functional mating surfaces are held to +/-0.025mm with Ra 0.8um finish, verified specifically for nuclear fuel storage requirements. Threaded features conform to ISO 965-2 Class 6g, verified with calibrated Go/No-Go ring gauges on 100% of production.

faq.q: Does Titanium Fuel Pool Rack Spacer require any post-machining surface treatment?
faq.a: Yes. nuclear fuel storage components require Thermal oxidation 700C 2h in air to grow controlled 300nm TiO2 barrier layer for H2 permeation reduction — tailored for nuclear fuel storage application. This restores the natural TiO2 passive layer removed during machining and provides the required surface properties for the specific service environment. Key parameters include surface finish Ra 0.8um and passive layer thickness verification per applicable standards.
